name: RRO Foods
category: Indian food company spanning edible oils, cheese and dairy products, and breakfast cereals
oneLineTruth: RRO wins when the product is not merely displayed, but made immediately useful: the right ingredient, in the right dish, for a kitchen people recognise.

principles: Prefer ingredient and cooking accuracy over decorative language.
Build appetite, usefulness and trust before asking for action.
Keep feed copy English-led and clean.
bannedMoves: Vague wellness language or exaggerated nutrition promises
Calling sesame oil a universal everyday oil
Forced poetry unrelated to the visible food or product
voice.emojiRule: No emojis in established feed copy unless a named campaign explicitly requires them.
voice.languageRule: English only for established feed copy; no Hinglish.

audiences.description: Household grocery decision-maker and everyday home cook
audiences.buyingSituation: Choosing dependable ingredients that taste good, perform reliably and feel trustworthy enough to serve the family
audiences.trigger: Seeing the exact product used convincingly in food they already want to make

audiences.description: Younger urban home cooks, bakers, hosts, food creators and professional kitchens
audiences.buyingSituation: Recreating restaurant-style food or solving a specific cooking, baking, breakfast or hosting need
audiences.trigger: A precise use case, credible texture and clear product-to-dish fit

principles: Use crisp commercial product photography and credible food texture.
Use warm natural light and golden-hour agricultural cues for oils.
Keep dairy and breakfast arrangements clean and useful.
Keep the product and exact pack visible as the hero.
avoid: Altering or redrawing labels, logos, pack colours, names or bottle proportions
Synthetic, over-glossy or visibly AI-generated food
Excessive food, crumbs, seeds or irrelevant garnish
A dish that does not genuinely use the featured product
Styling that obscures the pack or product name
Random luxury treatments that make everyday food inaccessible
Ingredients or props that conflict with the recipe, season or product

portfolios.name: RRO Oil
portfolios.positioning: Everyday, regional and specialist cooking oils
audience: People choosing oil by flavour and cooking application
namingRules: Use the exact product name printed on the approved pack.
Do not imply that every oil suits every dish or heat level.
Confirm whether an oil is refined, filtered or cold-pressed before describing it.
voiceRules: Ground education in a dish, technique or household behaviour.
visualRules: Never alter bottle proportions, labels or pack colours.

products.name: Primio Refined Groundnut Oil
products.role: Neutral-tasting oil for high-heat cooking, sauteing, deep-frying and versatile everyday use
restrictions: Do not describe it as filtered or cold-pressed.

products.name: Filtered Groundnut Oil
products.role: Flavour-forward oil retaining groundnut aroma and nutty sweetness for tadkas and traditional recipes
approvedFacts: Suitable for tadkas and traditional recipes
restrictions: Do not describe it as neutral-tasting.

products.name: Mastdil Premium Mustard Oil
products.role: Bold, pungent oil for pickles, marinades, tempering and North or East Indian dishes
approvedFacts: Suitable for pickles, marinades and tempering

products.name: TilDil Premium Til Oil
products.role: White sesame oil with nutty richness for South Indian dishes, tadkas, stir-fries, marinades and finishing

products.name: Deepdil Til Oil
products.role: Sesame oil for practical kitchen use; processing and distinction from TilDil remain unconfirmed
prohibitedClaims: Any processing, flavour or heat claim not confirmed from the current pack

products.name: Cold-Pressed Groundnut Oil
products.role: Nutty oil for medium-heat cooking, multi-cuisine recipes, drizzling and dressings

claimRules.rule: Nutrition and composition claims belong only to the exact SKU carrying them and must be rechecked against the current approved pack.
claimRules.safeAlternative: Describe the exact flavour, format, dish or serving use without the nutrition claim.

claimRules.rule: Oil processing, flavour and heat suitability must match the exact oil; cold-pressed oils must not be presented as the clearest choice for prolonged very high-heat frying.
claimRules.safeAlternative: Name only the configured dish and cooking application for the selected SKU.
claimRules.verificationSource: Current approved product pack and technical specification

claimRules.rule: Stock, delivery area and purchase calls must be verified for the portfolio and location before publication.
claimRules.safeAlternative: Use an awareness-led close with no purchase or geography claim.
claimRules.verificationSource: Current ecommerce availability and client confirmation

claimRules.rule: Do not publish unsupported medical, therapeutic or disease-prevention claims.
claimRules.safeAlternative: Remove the medical claim and speak only to verified product use.

claimRules.rule: Product name, label, logo, colour and pack proportions must remain exact in text and visuals.
claimRules.safeAlternative: Use the configured exact name and request the current approved packshot.
claimRules.verificationSource: Current approved product pack and packshot
